title: silent running clock
text: silent running clock. Big, clear, easy to read.  I purchased this for my laundry/work room.  It is silent, so far, and easily read.  It doesn't glow and is not lit if you are looking for something to be seen at night or in the dark - but in a well lit room, like mine, it works perfectly.  I am slightly disappointed as the plastic face lens (clear plastic) appears to have some etching on it - minus a star for that - but when I hung it wasn't as noticeable as up close and doesn't stop me from seeing the time. I have noticed that sometimes silent running clocks become noisy after a year or so - and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  So far, it's silent and runs perfectly.  You will need an AA battery - and a small nail to hang on the wall.  Easy peasy.  The clock itself is all plastic.  The edge appears to look a little like old bronze or dark weather wood?  Hope this info is helpful to you
